spans.s:
m. (-हिः)
1 A snake or serpent.
2 The sun.
3 A traveller.
4

Lead.
5

The name of a demon: see वृत्रासुर.
6 A name of RĀHU, the ascending node.
E.
आङ् prefixed to हन to hurt, इन् Uṇādi affix; injuring all or every thing, the आ of आङ् is made short.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Harmless, innocuous.
E.
अ neg. हिंसक mischievous; so अहिंस्र and अहिंस्रक.

f. (-सा)
Harmlessness, doing injury to nothing, one of the cardinal virtues of most Hindu sects, but particularly of the Bauddhas and Jainas.
E.
अ neg. हिंसा hurt.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uninjured.
E.
अ neg. हिंसित hurt.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं)
Innocuous, innocent, harmless.
f. (-स्रा)
The name of a plant, commonly Kurkavali: see कर्कटा.
E.
अ neg. and हिंस्रा injurious: than which there is none more so.

f. (-का)
The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
E.
अ neg. and हा to go or abandon, ङिक and टाप् affs.

m. (-कः)
1 A name of the inspired grammarian PĀṆ

INI.
2

The descending node.
E.
अहि a snake, or the constellation Aśleṣā, and ठक् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
Air, wind.
E.
अहि a serpent, and कान्त beloved; snakes being supposed to feed upon air.

m. (-त्रः)
1 The name of a country.
2 A milky or thorny plant: see मेषशृङ्गी.
f. (-त्रा)
1

Sugar.
2

A city.
E.
अहि a snake, and छत्र a parasol.

m. (-जित्)
1 A name of KṚṢṆ

Also of INDRA.
E.
अहि and जित् who conquers, from जि with क्विप् affix; subduing a demon in the form of a snake.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Hostile, inimical.
2 Hurtful, prejudicial.
m. (-तः)
An enemy.
n. (-तं)
Food, &c. contra indicated in a disease.
E.
अ neg. and हित friendly, fit, proper.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Placed, deposited.
2 Entertained, felt.
3 Comprising, containing.
4 Made, done.
E.
आङ्, धा to have or hold, part. affix क्त, form irr.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Adverse, inimical, acting unkindly.
E.
अहित unkind, कारिन् acting.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Hating, adverse, inimical.
E.
अहित and मनस् mind.

m. (-कः)
A snake-catcher or exhibiter.
E.
अहि and तुण्ड face, इकन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A juggler, a snake-catcher.
E.
अहि a snake, तुण्ड a mouth, and ठक् affix; playing with the mouth of a snake: the poisonous fangs being extracted, the snakes are suffered to bite their exhibitors.

m. (-द्विट्)
1 A name of

INDRA.
2
GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆ

A peacock.
4 An ichneumon.
E.
अहि and द्विष who hates, from द्विष् to hate, with क्विप् affix; serpent-hater or enemy.

f. (-का)
The natural enmity subsisting between a snake and an ichneumon.
E.
अहि, नकुल a mungoose, बुन aff.

m. (-कः)
The slough of a snake.
E.
अहि and निर्म्मोक the same.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of ŚEṢA, the sovereign of the snakes; also of VĀSUKI and others.
2 Any large serpent.
E.
अहि a snake, and पति lord; also similar compounds, as अहिनाथः, अहीन्द्रः, अहीशः, अहीश्वरः, &c.

m. (-कः)
A kind of boat.
E.
अहि and पुत्रक a son, resembling a snake.

Opium.
2

The saliva or venom of a snake.
E.
अहि a snake, and फेन foam.

m. (-ध्नः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

One of the demigods called RUDRAS.
E.
अहि and ब्रधि to bind, नक् Uṇādi affix; having his neck bound with snakes.

f. (-ता)
The twenty-sixth constellation.
E.
अहिब्रध्न and देवता presiding deity.

n. (-यं)
Mistrust or apprehension of treachery.
E.
अहि and भय fear; fear of a lurking snake as it were.

m. (-भुक्)
1 GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆ

A peacock.
E.
अहि and भुज who eats, from भुज and क्विप् affix; snake-eater.

m. (-शुः)
The sun.
E.
अ neg. हिम cold, and अंशु a ray; also similar compounds, as अहिमकर, अहिमरुचि, अहिमतेजस्, &c.

m. (-द्विट्)
1 GARUḌ

INDRA.
E.
अहि a snake or VṚTRĀSURA, and विद्विष् foe.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Possessed of, not deprived of.
2 Not outcaste or vile.
E.
अ neg. हीन deprived of.
m. (-नः)
1 A large snake, a serpent.
2 A particular sacrifice, one lasting twelve days.
E.
अहि a snake, and इन superior, or अहन् a day, and ख aff.

m. (-दी)
A witness who is not unit to give evidence.
E.
अ neg. हीनबादी a defective witness.

m. (-णिः)
A kind of snake, said to be two-headed.
E.
अहि, इर to move, and अणि aff.

m. (-कः)
A man of mixed origin, the son of a Niṣada father and Vaidehī^1 mother, employed as a watchman on the outside of jails, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260430.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Noted for good qualities.
E.
see अहतलक्षण.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Pained, grieved.
E.
आहित felt, व्यथा pain.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Noisy, uttering or making sound.
E.
आहित made, स्वन a sound.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Marked, spotted, stained.
E.
आहित made, अङ्क a spot.

m. (-ग्निः)
A Brahman who has preserved a sacred fire kept alive perpetually in a family, &c.
E.
आहित placed, and अग्नि a fire; by whom.
